entities.summary: Tove Kirsten Lindbo Larsen was a Danish Social Democrats politician who served as Minister for Ecclesiastical Affairs and Minister for Greenland from early 1981 to late 1982 in the government of Anker Jørgensen. She also served a total of 22 years as a member of the Folketing for firstly the Vestre Storkreds and then the Søndre Storkreds constituencies between most years from 1971 to 1998.
